title: Find the Closest Palindrome
summary: Given a string n representing an integer, find the nearest palindrome (excluding n itself) by minimizing the absolute difference.
statement: Given a string n representing an integer, find the nearest palindrome (excluding n itself) by minimizing the absolute difference. If two palindromes are equally close, choose the smaller one.
constraints: n is a decimal integer string from 1 through 10^18-1 with no leading zero.
Exclude n itself; minimize absolute difference and choose the smaller palindrome on ties.
hints: A closest palindrome comes from mirroring the current prefix or one of its immediate neighbors, plus digit-length boundaries.
Generate those five candidates and rank them after removing the input itself.
Mirror prefix-1, prefix, prefix+1; add 99…9 and 100…001; minimize (distance,value).
Any farther prefix changes the leading half more than a neighboring prefix, while boundary candidates cover carries that change digit length.
editorial: Any farther prefix changes the leading half more than a neighboring prefix, while boundary candidates cover carries that change digit length.

Zero and two tie at distance one, so return zero.
